_doc: Narrow, cited POSITION overrides (mail 052). Roster role (the school's listing) is kept distinct from the feed's match-box position (box_pos) and from any rotational role. One entry per player; no bulk rewrite. Applied to the player directory (PLAYERS) in build_hub.

evidence.text: Olivia Babcock -- RS (crawled roster pos_raw, data/raw/2026/rosters_2026.json)

overrides.why: The NCAA box lists her OH; Pitt's official roster lists RS. The directory showed the box's OH while the roster table showed OPP (RS mapped). Roster role now shown, box position kept as box_pos.
